title: O! O! jerked Lenehan, gasping at each stretch. O!
html_source:
Gilbert on Lenehan : ‘Lenehan, the humorous parasite, enters the bar and tries to flirt with the barmaids, but is snubbed. For Lenehan is one who 'never has it’, as Dubliners say.‘ Gilbert, S. James Joyce’s Ulysses, p215.

Lenehan’s name was borrowed from Matt Lenehan a reporter on the Irish Times but his character derives from Mick Hart, a friend of Joyce’s father, (Ellmann, R. James Joyce).
